1:import GiftUI
2:import GiftUISemanticCore
3:
4:/// Lexical join between Semantic Core's traversal and the existing State owner.
5:/// The bridge owns no model, read scope, or independent registration lifetime.
6:@usableFromInline
7:package struct ObservableSemanticBodyBinding<
8:    Model: ObservableStateModel & ~Copyable,
9:    Identity: Equatable & Sendable,
10:    Domain: _GiftUIReadDomain
11:>: ~Copyable, ~Escapable, SemanticStatefulBinding
12:where Domain.Slot == ObservableModelReadSlot<Model> {
13:    @usableFromInline
14:    package typealias Failure = ObservableStateError
15:    @usableFromInline
16:    internal let models: ObservableModelScope<Model, Model.Schema>
17:    @usableFromInline
18:    internal let root: ObservableStateRootScope<Model, Identity>
19:
20:    @_lifetime(copy models, copy root)
21:    package init(
22:        models: consuming ObservableModelScope<Model, Model.Schema>,
23:        root: consuming ObservableStateRootScope<Model, Identity>,
24:        domain: Domain.Type
25:    ) {
26:        self.models = consume models
27:        self.root = consume root
28:    }
29:
30:    @inlinable
31:    @inline(__always)
32:    package borrowing func evaluate<Declaration: View>(
33:        _ declaration: borrowing Declaration,
34:        beforeBody: () -> SemanticExpansionError?,
35:        body: (borrowing _GiftUIFrameRead<Domain>) throws(_GiftUIAccessFailure) -> Declaration.Body
36:    ) -> SemanticBodyEvaluation<Declaration.Body, ObservableStateError>
37:    where Declaration.Domain == Domain, Declaration.Body.Domain == Domain {
38:        guard root.belongs(to: models) else { return .bindingFailure(.incompatibleAssociation) }
39:        if let failure = beforeBody() { return .semanticFailure(failure) }
40:        do throws(_GiftUIAccessFailure) {
41:            return .body(try models.withRead(Domain.self, body))
42:        } catch { return .accessFailure(error) }
43:    }
44:
45:    @inlinable
46:    @inline(__always)
47:    package borrowing func evaluateStateful<Declaration: View & _GiftUIObservableStateHost>(
48:        _ declaration: borrowing Declaration,
49:        structuralIdentity: Identity,
50:        beforeBody: () -> SemanticExpansionError?,
51:        body: (borrowing Declaration, borrowing _GiftUIFrameRead<Domain>)
52:            throws(_GiftUIAccessFailure) -> Declaration.Body
53:    ) -> SemanticBodyEvaluation<Declaration.Body, ObservableStateError>
54:    where Declaration.Domain == Domain, Declaration.Body.Domain == Domain {
55:        guard root.belongs(to: models) else { return .bindingFailure(.incompatibleAssociation) }
56:        do throws(ObservableStateError) {
57:            return try root.withBoundDeclaration(declaration, identity: structuralIdentity) {
58:                (bound) throws(ObservableStateError) in
59:                if let failure = beforeBody() { return .semanticFailure(failure) }
60:                do throws(_GiftUIAccessFailure) {
61:                    return .body(
62:                        try models.withRead(Domain.self) {
63:                            (read) throws(_GiftUIAccessFailure) in
64:                            try body(bound, read)
65:                        })
66:                } catch { return .accessFailure(error) }
67:            }
68:        } catch { return .bindingFailure(error) }
69:    }
70:}
